title: Abraham Lincoln — Honest Abe
memory_verse: "The Lord detests lying lips, but he delights in people who are trustworthy." — Proverbs 12:22 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn about Abraham Lincoln and how his honesty and faith in God helped him lead America during a difficult time.
content: Abraham Lincoln was the 16th president of the United States. People called him 'Honest Abe' because he always told the truth.
When Lincoln was a boy, he loved to read and learn. He grew up in a small log cabin. He worked very hard and trusted God with his life.
As president, Lincoln helped keep America together during a very hard time called the Civil War. He prayed often and asked God for wisdom.
Lincoln believed that all people are created equal because God made every person special. He is remembered as one of America's greatest presidents.
activity: Build a small log cabin out of craft sticks or pretzel sticks. Talk about how Lincoln grew up in a simple home but did great things.
discussion: Why was Abraham Lincoln called 'Honest Abe'?
Why is it important to always tell the truth?
How did Lincoln show that he cared about all people?
